fields.description: Runs the daily ingest, driver collection and anomaly detection pipeline.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Each row is queried separately. Only add a member account if it is not already covered by a payer account listed here, otherwise its cost is counted twice.
fields.label: Accounts

fields.description: AWS restates recent days. Every run re-fetches this many trailing days and replaces what it stored.
fields.label: Restatement Days

fields.description: Daily cost rows older than this are deleted. 0 keeps everything.
fields.label: Retention Days

fields.description: How far back Backfill History reaches. Cost Explorer charges $0.01 per request and holds 14 months of daily data.
fields.label: Backfill Months

fields.description: Trailing days used to build a baseline for each series.
fields.label: Baseline Days

fields.description: A day is a spike when it deviates from the same-weekday median by more than this many median absolute deviations.
fields.label: Spike MAD Threshold

fields.description: Anomalies costing less than this per day are not recorded, however large the percentage.
fields.label: Minimum Daily Cost Impact (USD)

fields.description: A level shift is reported when the step is at least this large.
fields.label: Level Shift Minimum Change

fields.description: Growth is organic when its driver grew to within this many percentage points of it.
fields.label: Organic Tolerance

fields.description: Series averaging less than this per day are ignored entirely.
fields.label: Minimum Series Cost (USD/day)
DigitalOcean Rates
fields.description: DigitalOcean publishes no price API for block storage or snapshots, so these are the rates we are charged. Droplets are priced from the sizes API and need no setting.
